title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 3: trusting Yahweh with all your heart, honoring him with your first fruits, and the worth of wisdom.

questions.text: What will the father's teaching and commandments add to the son who keeps them?
questions.explanation: Keeping the teaching and commandments will add length of days, years of life, and peace.

answers.text: Length of days, years of life, and peace
Silver, choice gold, and precious rubies
A great name among all the nations

questions.text: Where should kindness and truth be written?
questions.explanation: The son must bind kindness and truth around his neck and write them on the tablet of his heart.

answers.text: On the doorposts of the house
On a scroll in the temple
On the tablet of your heart

questions.text: How does the saying continue: "Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don't lean on..."?
questions.explanation: The verse says to trust in Yahweh with all your heart and not to lean on your own understanding.

questions.text: What happens when you honor Yahweh with your substance and the first fruits of all your increase?
questions.explanation: Honor Yahweh with your substance and first fruits, and your barns will be filled with plenty and your vats will overflow with new wine.

answers.text: Your enemies will be at peace with you on every side
Your days will be multiplied and your years increased
Your foot will never stumble on any of your paths
Your barns will be filled with plenty and your vats will overflow with new wine

questions.explanation: Whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

questions.text: According to this chapter, wisdom's good profit is better than what?
questions.explanation: Wisdom's good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

questions.text: What is in wisdom's right hand?
questions.explanation: Length of days is in wisdom's right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

questions.text: What is wisdom called for those who lay hold of her?
questions.explanation: Wisdom is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her, and happy is everyone who retains her.

questions.text: What is promised about your sleep when you lie down?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when you lie down you will not be afraid, and your sleep will be sweet.

answers.text: An angel will guard your bed
Your sleep will be taken away

questions.text: This chapter contrasts the mockers with the humble: what does Yahweh give to the humble?
questions.explanation: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
